name: Perturbation response: attributes.scope_note
description: Correction made by the 2026-11-16 cross-batch coordinator fix pass. The previous value is kept here.

attributes.previous_value: Predict expression changes after unseen perturbations.
attributes.value: Predict expression changes under a held-out perturbation condition. The held-out condition need not be an agent the model has never seen: a protocol under this task may hold out a dose, a time point or a cell context of an agent whose other conditions are available in training or in context, and each protocol record states which.
